subject: Private/Dedicated deployment: compact network isolation & evidence pack request
body:
--- Message 1 of 5 ---
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@bluecove.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluecove.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: isolation overview for Private deployment

Hi Avery,

Thanks for taking this on. BlueCove is evaluating Redwood for a private VPC deployment and our security team needs a concise architecture overview focused on network isolation. Specifically we want: 
- a network diagram showing control-plane vs data-plane boundaries for the Private offering,
- proof points for tenant isolation (control plane, KV cache, egress controls), and
- a short mapping to SOC 2 / SIG questions related to segmentation and egress control.

Can you send an evidence packet (diagram + matrix) and propose a 45-minute walkthrough next week? We're aiming to complete the SIG review by May 14.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of InfoSec
BlueCove Health

--- Message 2 of 5 ---
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@bluecove.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: isolation overview for Private deployment

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear ask. We'll put together a compact evidence pack that addresses the three bullets and include a one-page narrative for SIG reviewers.

Proposed next steps:
1) We will share a draft packet (diagram + CSV mapping) by EOD Monday (May 3).
2) Schedule a 45-minute walkthrough the week of May 10 — please let me know preferred times.
3) If there are SOC 2 control IDs you want specifically mapped, drop them into the thread and Karthik will include them.

Artifacts we'll attach: network diagram (PDF), segmentation assertions (CSV), and a short control-mapping memo (PDF).

Quick clarifications for the packet: is BlueCove planning a fully private on-prem install or a VPC-private deployment hosted in a third-party cloud? The isolation model we show differs slightly.

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
cal: +1 415-555-0147

--- Message 3 of 5 ---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@bluecove.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: isolation overview for Private deployment

Hi all — attaching the first-draft diagram and the segmentation matrix. Short notes inline: 

- Control plane: our Private control plane runs in the customer VPC or isolated on-prem control tier; API endpoints are reachable over customer-managed networking and use mutual TLS with certs stored in the customer's KMS (we reference KMS/HSM integration in the memo).
- Data plane: inference GPUs and KV caches are in dedicated subnets; we support physical tenant isolation via reserved pools (Dedicated) or logical isolation via namespace-level tenancy (Private).
- Egress: default-deny egress ACLs with explicit NAT gateways per tenant when allowed; VPC flow logs + host-level egress filters recorded in audit logs.

Attachments included (stubs):
- redwood-private-network-diagram-v2.pdf (diagram: control-plane, data-plane, egress, peering and BGP notes)
- segmentation-assertions-20270501.csv (rows: assertion id, requirement, evidence pointer, owner)

Let me know if you want the diagram annotated for BlueCove's particular account (we can swap in their CIDR ranges).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Principal Architect, Security — Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 of 5 ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@bluecove.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: isolation overview for Private deployment

Maria/Avery — adding a short SOC 2 mapping note. The segmentation assertions attach to common SOC 2 CC6 / CC7 areas (change and configuration, logical and physical access as it relates to network segmentation). For SIG, map the CSV column 'evidence_pointer' to the SIG question ids in column 'sig_qid'.

I also opened an internal ticket to produce a formal 'Isolation Narrative' doc and a minimal runbook for tenant eviction and emergency egress revocation — tracking JIRA SEC-8431.

If BlueCove has a preferred SIG template, send it over and we'll transpose the CSV.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

--- Message 5 of 5 ---
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: isolation overview for Private deployment

Hi Maria — attached is the consolidated evidence packet we discussed.

Attachments: redwood-private-network-diagram-v2.pdf; segmentation-assertions-20270501.csv; isolation-narrative-v1.pdf (short runbook + control-mapping).

We scheduled the walkthrough for Tue, May 11 at 10:00 AM PT (45 minutes) — invite sent to security@bluecove.com. Agenda: 1) architecture overview (10m) 2) segmentation assertions walk-through (20m) 3) Q&A and next steps (15m).

Please confirm the time works or propose an alternate. If you want BlueCove-specific CIDRs added to the diagram ahead of the call, send them over and Kim will update it.

Regards,
Avery Johnson
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Avery_johnson@redwood.com
